description: De-duplicated references parsed from the archive's HTML reference anchors (PSCompPars *_reflink, disc_refname; PS pl_refname/st_refname/sy_refname). Labels are HTML-entity-decoded; relative archive links made absolute. Rows are ordered by descending number of uses in the published files (ties: case-insensitive label); indices are only stable within one snapshot.

descriptions.refstr: Archive reference key (e.g. 'AGOL_ET_AL__2021', 'STASSUN_ET_AL__2019', 'CALCULATED_VALUE'); not unique on its own (same key can carry different labels, e.g. 'TICv8')
descriptions.label: Display label (e.g. 'Agol et al. 2021', 'TICv8', 'Q1-Q17 DR25 KOI Table', 'Calculated Value')
descriptions.url: Link to the reference (mostly NASA ADS abstract pages); null if none
descriptions.kind: 'reference' (published value: paper or catalogue) or 'calculated' (computed by the archive, no uncertainties)
